related.title: Git：內容定址物件與 Merkle 關係
related.titleEn: Git: content-addressed objects and Merkle relationships
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：研究5驗收：交付merge-trace.csv、tombstone反例與讀寫放大定義；不將180筆視為任何實測資料庫大小。 請保留本研究的輸入、逐筆中間狀態與不符合條件時的處置。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 acceptance: Deliver merge-trace.csv, the tombstone counterexample and read/write-amplification definitions;180 records are a fixture, not a measured database size. Retain inputs, intermediate state and the disposition when the criterion is not met.
related.difference: 建立blob header與內容bytes再hash；tree項保留全部十個檔名，不把去重誤作刪檔。
related.differenceEn: Hash the blob header plus content bytes; keep all ten tree names instead of mistaking deduplication for file deletion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
LSM將新寫入放在較新序號，合併時按鍵與序號決定可見版本；tombstone不能在仍有舊版本時過早丟棄。
本課數值核對：100+100-20 = 180 records；另一項核對：10/180 = 0.0555555555556 ratio。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。

Git物件身分由型別、長度與內容決定；tree保存名稱與物件參照。相同內容可共用blob，不代表不同路徑同一歷史。
本課數值核對：1+2 = 3 blobs；另一項核對：10-3 = 7 blobs。兩項若屬不同量綱，不得直接相除或相減。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
LSM updates carry newer sequences; merging chooses visibility by key and sequence. Tombstones cannot be dropped while older versions may remain visible.
Numeric audit: 100+100-20 = 180 records; second audit: 10/180 = 0.0555555555556 ratio. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.

Git object identity includes type, length and content; trees store names and object references. Identical content can share a blob without sharing path history.
Numeric audit: 1+2 = 3 blobs; second audit: 10-3 = 7 blobs. Quantities with different dimensions must not be directly divided or subtracted.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

同步程式先完成，microtask checkpoint再處理排隊工作；timer延遲不是精確排程保證。
